name: Data quality
short_description: The degree to which data is complete, consistent, accurate, fresh and unique; in Microsoft Purview it is measured with rules and scores that roll up from columns to assets, data products and domains.

evidence.quote: Data quality in the unified catalog answers that with rules and scores a rule is a check
instead of where they need to check for the data quality
anybody that's been involved in the data space, data quality, data governance
when you had the right prompt in and when you had also good data quality
